title: Ambush on the White Dragon Hill
summary: With news of a Sovereign's treasure spreading, Su Xuan offers to turn back, but the team presses on to the White Dragon Hill. At night Dragon Demon Guards lure Su Xuan away and four late-phase Heavenly Fusion attackers go for the others; Mu Chen hides the injured Su Ling'er and leads the pursuers off, then turns on them with the Great Buddha Art and kills them all. The attackers carry the Dragon Demon Palace's mark, and Su Xuan explains the old war between the Dragon Demon Palace and the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy, and why Shen Cangsheng hunts Mo Longzi. At the site where the White Dragon Sovereign died, his image appears in the sky as the treasure's entrance opens, and Bai Dong taunts Mu Chen. Inside, the team is scattered; Jiuyou points Mu Chen to Flame Spiritual Lotuses and the hope of a Flame Immortal Lotus, guarded by Flame-Devouring Pythons, and Bai Dong's party finds him.
events: The team decides to continue despite the danger

The team is split up inside; Mu Chen finds Flame Spiritual Lotuses and a Flame-Devouring Python
cultivation: The attackers are four people at Heavenly Fusion, Late Phase (Bai Dong later says ten were sent); Mu Chen, at initial-phase Heavenly Fusion, kills them himself.
